sources.rule: Clearance depends on Uimp; creepage depends on Ui, pollution degree and material group. Verify after short-circuit withstand testing.
Size neutral for imbalance and triplen harmonics; do not automatically reduce neutral cross-section.
BKN uses 35 mm DIN rail and 17.8 mm nominal width per pole. Rotation, terminal positions and installation clearances require the exact model manual.
Handle and LOTO projection must fit the gap behind doors.
H07V-R 1x150 example: recommended bend radius 6 times cable diameter; do not generalize to every cable.

user_design_policy.boundary_policy: 200A uses minimum250mm provisionally; raise only for cable/lug envelope; 300A uses400mm
user_design_policy.busbar_section: select by current, temperature, short circuit and supports; no section inferred from photo

cable_space_policy.armoured_multicore: do not use single core radius for full cable; distinguish sheath breakout and individual tails
cable_space_policy.purpose: reserve connection space for cable lugs and minimum cable bending radius at main MCCB terminals
cable_space_policy.top_gap_reference: MCCB body top to inside roof; cable terminal offset must be included
cable_space_policy.bend_radius_reference: manufacturer minimum internal bend radius; convert centreline radius before calculating envelope
cable_space_policy.verification: current-based spacing is a project starting rule, not a universal cable bending standard
cable_space_policy.route_validation: check actual terminal exit direction and cable/lug envelope in side view before fabrication

form_resize_policy.objective: smallest source-form dimensions fitting actual component and connection envelopes
form_resize_policy.hardware: preserve physical size; translate rigid hardware using explicit face anchors
form_resize_policy.lock_anchor: centre of owning door face unless source metadata specifies otherwise
form_resize_policy.hinge_anchor: owning door edge with source edge offset preserved
form_resize_policy.mounting_holes: preserve diameter and specified edge offsets
form_resize_policy.views: synchronize outer door, inner door, mounting plate, side and top projections
form_resize_policy.missing_anchor_metadata: block automatic resizing; select a suitable source form or require anchor review

description.d4: Khoảng bên tới vỏ khi In > 200 A

design_variables.effective_gap: max(selected d1/d2/d3, calculated cable/lug envelope); missing cable data remains provisional
design_variables.missing_value_policy: null means unknown; never replace with zero
